$comment: The product public page template (krizaka-internal#4692): structure only, no words (they are in messages/site, `productPage`). The scenes are the media the registry lists for `page`/`sceneRole`, in its order; the budget is the most words each section may say, held by lib/product-page.test.ts. The story is the one journey the page tells while it scrolls, step by step (STORY_STEPS); its bird is the guide that appears at each step.
